record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain newest-128 truncation and cumulative observed positions; replace fixed pooling with causal weights proportional to exp(cos(h_t,h_j)-(t-j)/4), mixing 0.75*h_t+0.25*pool_t. For the learning objective, replace uniform BPR averaging with equal-user averaging of per-position BPR weighted by exp(-(last_valid-t)/8). Content-sensitive pooling and recent-target emphasis may jointly improve next-item ranking. Preserve frequency features, HSTU blocks and optimizer settings; use one checkpoint per category and identical readout in the predictor writer.
